definitions.explanation: The look on the face of someone pleased with their own success and wanting it noticed. Affectionate when used of a child, mildly critical when used of an adult.

examples.japanese: {得意顔|とくいがお}で{話|はな}している。
examples.english: He's talking with a triumphant look on his face.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{百点|ひゃくてん}のテストを{得意顔|とくいがお}で{見|み}せた。
examples.english: My little brother proudly showed off his perfect test score.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{手柄|てがら}を{得意顔|とくいがお}で{語|かた}る{人|ひと}は、あまり{好|す}かれない。
examples.english: People who recount their own achievements with a smug expression aren't much liked.

notes:
Nearly always adverbial: {得意顔|とくいがお}で + a verb of speaking or showing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得意顔|とくいがお}で{話|はな}す: to speak with a triumphant air
- {得意顔|とくいがお}になる: to look pleased with oneself

EXPRESSION SERIES:
{顔|かお} attaches to many words to name a facial expression:
- {泣|な}き{顔|がお}: a tearful face
- {知|し}らん{顔|かお}: a look of feigned ignorance
- したり{顔|がお}: a self-satisfied look — close to {得意顔|とくいがお}, but more clearly disapproving

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誇|ほこ}らしげ: looking proud — warmer, without the hint of showing off
